params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The OCID of the compartment.

params.name: name
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the given name exactly.

params.name: capacityType
params.description:
A filter to only return resources matching the capacity type enum. Values are
case-insensitive.

params.name: featureSet
params.description:
A filter to only return resources matching the feature set. Values are
case-insensitive.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description:
A filter to only return resources matching the lifecycle state. The state
value is case-insensitive.

params.name: limit
params.description:
For list pagination. The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a paginated
"List" call. For important details about how pagination works, see
[List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

Example: `50`

params.name: page
params.description:
For list pagination. The value of the `opc-next-page` response header from the previous "List"
call. For important details about how pagination works, see
[List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
The field to sort by (one column only). Default sort order is
ascending exception of `timeCreated` column (descending).

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either ascending (`ASC`) or descending (`DESC`).
